title: Autopilot resume script failed - Start-Process had no working directory
what_happened: resume_reconcile.ps1 waited correctly until 00:05Z, but push failed instantly with "File 'task_reconcile.py' does not exist" and the script stopped ("push failed outright; stopping"). Job aborted at 00:05:21Z; had to push manually at 01:36Z after user said 'resume reconcile'.
root_cause: Script invoked via Start-Process -FilePath powershell -File ... without -WorkingDirectory; kaggle CLI resolves -f task_reconcile.py relative to process CWD (System32 or parent shell cwd), not the script's $wd. Script used $wd for log/result paths but never Set-Location $wd before calling kaggle.
what_i_did_wrong: Assumed the detached process would inherit the working directory used in interactive pushes. Did not dry-run the actual push path (dry-run only exercised status/log, not the push command's file resolution).
corrective_action: Added Set-Location $wd (and full-path -f) to resume_reconcile.ps1; manual push v5 succeeded same day. Rule for future detached automation: always set CWD inside the script, never rely on launch-time environment.
cost: Delayed completion ~1.5h (00:05 -> 01:36 UTC); no quota spent on the failed attempt.
